entities.summary: The Keikyu Zushi Line  is a 5.9-kilometre (3.7 mi) private railway line in Japan, operated by Keikyū. It connects Kanazawa-hakkei in Kanazawa-ku, Yokohama with Zushi·Hayama in Zushi, all in Kanagawa Prefecture.
